title: Atlassian Agentic Forge A2UI catalog
description: A dedicated Forge catalog. ResultPanel shows a completed result from a literal title and summary. MultipleChoice selects one or more options. It is not a superset of the ADS catalog.
instructions: Send A2UI v0.9 messages, each with "version": "v0.9". Start with createSurface using this catalogId, then send updateComponents. This catalog contains ResultPanel and MultipleChoice. It is not a superset of the ADS catalog. ResultPanel is a completed result: set component to "ResultPanel" and provide title and summary as literal strings. summary keeps authored line breaks. Do not add actions, data-binding path objects, or child component ids to ResultPanel. MultipleChoice chooses one or more options. Set options to an array of { label, value }. Set value to a string array or a { "path": "/json/pointer" } binding; the renderer writes the selected values back to that path. style is "select" (default) or "action". Use updateDataModel to seed a bound MultipleChoice value. Do not invent other component names.

label.description: A literal string OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

value.description: Stable identifier persisted to the data model.
Selected values. A string array, or { "path": "/pointer" } so the selection is written back. Read that path to see what was picked.

multiple.description: Allow more than one selection. Defaults to false. Ignored when style is "action".

style.description: "select" (default) is a dropdown. "action" is a menu. Picking an item writes value and fires onChange.

placeholder.description: A literal string OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

disabled.description: A literal boolean OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

invalid.description: A literal boolean OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

filterable.description: Show a search box in the dropdown. Defaults to true. Ignored when style is "action".

onChange.description: Fired after the selection is written to value. It has no arguments. Read the value path to see the choice, or put context on the action, for example { "event": { "name": "picked", "context": { "from": "fruit-menu" } } }.

summary.description: Result body. Line breaks are shown as authored.

label.description: A short string used by assistive technologies to convey the purpose of an element.

description.description: Additional information provided by assistive technologies about an element.

ComponentCommon.description: Properties shared by every A2UI component.

ComponentId.description: The unique identifier for a component.

path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

DataBinding.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

call.description: The name of the function to call.

FunctionCall.description: Invokes a named function on the client.
